## Step 8: Review a pull request

_Awesome! You've linked your issue to a pull request! :link:_

Before merging changes, it's important to review them. Pull request reviews help maintain code quality and share knowledge across your team.

**What is a pull request review?**: A _[pull request review](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/reviewing-changes-in-pull-requests/about-pull-request-reviews)_ is a way to provide feedback on proposed changes. Reviewers can comment on specific lines of code, approve changes, or request modifications before merging.

**Why review pull requests?**: Reviews help you:
- Catch bugs and issues before they reach production
- Share knowledge about the codebase
- Ensure code quality and consistency
- Learn from other developers' approaches
- Build team collaboration skills

### :keyboard: Activity: Add a review comment

Let's practice reviewing your own pull request. In a real project, other team members would review your work, but for this exercise, you'll review your own changes.

1. Navigate to your pull request (the one you just created with the `add-favorite-color` branch).

2. Click on the **Files changed** tab to see the differences in your code.

   ![screenshot of files changed tab](https://docs.github.com/assets/cb-61903/mw-1440/images/help/pull_requests/pull-request-tabs-changed-files.webp)

3. Hover over the line where you added your favorite color. You'll see a blue **+** icon appear.

4. Click the **+** icon to add a comment on that specific line.

5. In the comment box, write a constructive comment like:
   
   ```
   Great addition! This makes the profile more personal. 🎨
   ```

6. Click **Add single comment** (not "Start a review" for this exercise).

7. Now go back to the **Conversation** tab of your pull request.

8. Scroll down and click the green **Review changes** button.

9. Select **Approve** and add a comment like:
   
   ```
   LGTM! (Looks Good To Me) Ready to merge. ✅
   ```

10. Click **Submit review**.

11. Once you've submitted your review approval, Mona will verify your work and guide you to the next step!

<details>
<summary>Having trouble? 🤷</summary><br/>

If you don't get feedback, here are some things to check:
- Make sure you added at least one comment on a specific line in the Files changed tab
- Verify you submitted an approval review
- Confirm you're on the correct pull request

</details>
